purpose: Name and current-function identity explorations. Opaque concept artboards, not final transparent app icons. No application assets replaced.

concepts.name: 命令泊位
concepts.meaning: D 形泊位接住命令提示符，把 Dock 与 Shell 合成一个符号。
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Brand: DockShell, an original macOS SSH terminal client. Dock means a place to dock and organize remote connections; Shell means an interactive command terminal. Current features include independent session tabs, equal horizontal/vertical terminal splits, and verified SSH host identity. Make an original contemporary identity, not a clone of any commercial terminal app.
Deliver ONE square concept artboard, one resolved design only, not a contact sheet. Use generous empty space, a precise vector-like graphic with clean edges, and strong small-size silhouette. No application screenshot, no mockup device, no rounded-square app container, no generic shield or padlock, no server-rack illustration, no stock clipart, no decorative code rain. Do not cram all product features into the mark. Treat the named semantic link below as the main idea. No captions, numbers, slogan, watermarks or extra marks.

Subject: a broad, low, open-right D-shaped docking berth in midnight navy, with a compact coral solid right-facing command chevron fitting into its mouth. The dock must feel like one thick geometric quay, not a box around a generic terminal icon. Use the chevron and the shaped empty harbor as one coherent silhouette. Architecture-led, two bold masses, near-square but slightly wider than tall. Flat navy and coral on warm porcelain white. Symbol centered slightly above the middle; small exact wordmark "DockShell" below in understated medium-weight sans serif. No gradients.

Subject: three solid upright session tabs docking into a shared horizontal base, forming a memorable compact asymmetric comb silhouette. Three independent stems with flat square ends, the middle stem taller, the right stem shortest; base and left/middle stems one deep-ink shape, rightmost tab vivid chartreuse. The base is a docking platform, the upright modules are independent SSH sessions. No UI outlines or tiny controls. Strong modular industrial graphic, flat ink black and acidic lime on soft light gray. Center the compact emblem with the exact small wordmark "DockShell" below, custom-looking monospaced lettering. Do not look like a bar chart: use broad tabs, narrow uniform gaps, and visibly slotted feet.

Subject: an original custom typographic wordmark spelling EXACTLY "DockShell" in one line, uppercase D and S only, all letters present and legible. Bold engineered monospace-inspired glyphs, dark forest green on warm white. A single short bright green rectangular terminal cursor follows the final l at the text baseline. The type IS the logo; no separate icon, no enclosing box, no additional text. Wide horizontal lockup on a square artboard with generous whitespace. Understated crafted contemporary software identity, flat, no texture.

notes.note: 多会话底座的含义需要说明，轮廓仍可能被看作柱状图。
横向字标适合官网、关于窗口，应用图标需要另行提炼。
主机指纹是设计隐喻，图形并非实际指纹或安全状态指示。
